svg.title: Simplified platform moderation system
svg.desc: Annotation data feeds model fitting and evaluation outside the deployed moderation-system boundary. Fitting installs a toxicity predictor; this installation is not a removal command. Inside the boundary, a posted comment enters the predictor. The predictor supplies a score to the moderation rule, which is the controller. The rule issues hide or restore commands to the post-visibility process and receives visibility status. The author receives a decision notice and can return an appeal or correction request to the rule. This feedback does not guarantee timely restoration or preservation of participation. Gray arrows denote data or installation, black arrows control actions, and blue arrows status, notices, or appeals. Labels identify every path independently of color.
